description: This file defines the POSProfile class and related functions for managing POS profiles in an ERP system, including validation, default setting, and querying functionalities.

classes.name: POSProfile
classes.description: Represents a Point of Sale profile with validation and default management methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the POS profile before saving.

methods.name: validate_default_profile
methods.description: Ensures only one default POS profile per user.

methods.name: validate_all_link_fields
methods.description: Validates that linked accounts, cost centers, and warehouses belong to the same company.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_groups
methods.description: Checks for duplicate item and customer groups.

methods.name: validate_payment_methods
methods.description: Validates payment methods, ensuring one default and valid accounts.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Updates default settings after profile changes.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Resets defaults when profile is deleted.

methods.name: set_defaults
methods.description: Sets user or global defaults for POS visibility.
